scope: CONVAL02 same live T3 parent; no new calculation, model, scorer, raw, physics, active APP02 or root-document access

exact_predeclared_rules.effective_version: V2, explicitly pinned by stored_decision /source_sha256 and /parent_fit_approval/contract_sha256; V1 preserved as proposal provenance
exact_predeclared_rules.V1_objective_pointer: contract_v1 /objective (broad unchanged-original-qualification objective; does not contain the later explicit <=0 delta-JM acquisition condition)
exact_predeclared_rules.labels: delta JF and delta JM are action minus same-parent H150; margins are original requirements relative to same-parent B
proposal_conditions: exclude any already attempted semantic x3
max over all six models of predicted delta JF mean+2*spread <= best observed originally qualified delta JF - 0.01 N*s
max over all six models of predicted delta JM mean+2*spread <= 0 (relative to H150)
min over every model and original continuous component of absolute margin mean-2*spread >= 0

original_task_JM_qualification.pointer: original_motion_protocol /primary/moment_integral_ratio; evidence_adapter motion_margins lines68-69; continuous_owner result_row lines106-112
original_task_JM_qualification.distinction: This original qualification allows a JM tradeoff inside the original bound. It does not require JM(action)<=JM(H150). ILC/fixed actual comparisons use original qualification; descriptive force increments are not a joint cost-dominance claim.

exact_predeclared_rules.benchmark_vs_proposal_permission: selector line149 selects best observed qualified action without a separate delta-JM<=0 filter. Thus the force benchmark may use an already qualified JM-tradeoff action, while any new BO proposal must additionally satisfy no upper-bound JM increase versus H150. This is the frozen conservative acquisition contract, not equal objective permissions across arms.
exact_predeclared_rules.uncertainty: All mean+/-2spread terms are predeclared DATA_LIMITED heuristics, not calibrated probabilities or proof that the actual unexecuted task would fail.

interpretation: Both untried grid points -0.125 and +0.125 failed all three non-duplicate acceptance tests: conservative JF improvement, JM-component upper bound, and at least one continuous original-component lower margin. The three other grid points were already attempted and cannot be new proposals.

ABSTAIN is not a missing-data, failed prerequisite, unexecuted fit, or lack-of-local-response identification result. Six clean unique observations and all prerequisite gates were available; 42 multi-RHS solves with 47 heads completed.

JM nonincrease is an extra objective permission restriction relative to the original ratio<=1.25 qualification. It is not the sole cause here: both untried points also failed conservative JF and motion-margin gates. Removing JM alone would not remove their stored other rejection reasons; no relaxed-objective rerun was performed.

The JF/motion rejections are model-and-heuristic-bound based insufficiency to authorize this acquisition, not empirical failure of the unexecuted candidates, model-family falsification, or demonstration that every pointwise mean is poor. No new numerical attribution between mean error and spread was computed.
The stored grid summarizes only the minimum component lower margin, not the identity of its argmin head. This review does not recompute predictions to localize that head.
Do not compare BO ABSTAIN with ILC/fixed JF gains as if all were given identical JM permissions, and do not count a proposed/abstained action as an executed physics candidate.
